recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31578 unless a future final Patient Care decision changes the representation or adds example guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-31578 was a Published Patient Care change request with Persuasive resolution asking to change AllergyIntolerance.reaction.manifestation to CodeableReference (Observation) for R5.
initial_application: The request was applied by commit e589fcc9059e3dddf8874f818060403418da0ccc, which added a J#31578 committee note and changed AllergyIntolerance.reaction.manifestation from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference with targetProfile Observation in source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini, so its StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. Current source still has the CodeableReference type and Observation target, and the current AllergyIntolerance search-parameter bundle has both manifestation-code and manifestation-reference paths for the CodeableReference concept/reference split. Patient Care minutes reference the Jira item, and bounded Jira/Zulip searches found no final later decision reversing this change.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch because the current active FHIR source already implements the requested CodeableReference (Observation) change and surrounding generated-source inputs are consistent with that representation.

related_jiras.note: Later Submitted R6 request asking for examples of manifestation Observations; not a final reversal of the CodeableReference change and not decided here.
